#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fix Branch-4: area 20 stub + firewall connection tracking."""
from netmiko import ConnectHandler
import time

conn = ConnectHandler(host="192.168.122.24", device_type="mikrotik_routeros", username="admin", password="test")

# Fix area 20 type to stub
out = conn.send_command("/routing ospf area set [find name=area20] type=stub")
print("Stub fix:", out)

# Fix firewall: rule 0 needs connection-state=established,related
# Remove old rule 0 and re-add with connection tracking
out = conn.send_command("/ip firewall filter remove [find comment~\"allow return\"]")
print("Remove old rule 0:", out)

# Add proper rule with connection tracking at position 0
out = conn.send_command('/ip firewall filter add chain=forward action=accept connection-state=established,related comment="allow return traffic" place-before=0')
print("Add tracked rule:", out)

time.sleep(10)

# Verify
out = conn.send_command("/routing ospf area print detail")
print("\nArea after fix:", out)

out = conn.send_command("/routing ospf neighbor print detail")
print("\nOSPF neighbors:", out)

out = conn.send_command("/ip firewall filter print terse")
print("\nFirewall rules:", out)

out = conn.send_command("/ip route print terse")
print("\nRoutes:", out)

conn.disconnect()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fix Hub-B: virtual link peer address (use router-id, not IP)."""
from netmiko import ConnectHandler
import time

conn = ConnectHandler(host="192.168.122.13", device_type="vyos", username="vyos", password="test")

commands = [
    "delete protocols ospf area 10 virtual-link 172.16.10.9",
    "set protocols ospf area 10 virtual-link 10.255.0.2 authentication md5 key-id 1 md5-key LabArea0Key",
]

out = conn.send_config_set(commands, exit_config_mode=False)
print("Config set:", out)

out = conn.commit()
print("Commit:", out)

out = conn.send_command_timing("save")
print("Save:", out)

out = conn.send_command_timing("exit")
print("Exit:", out)

# Verify VyOS config
out = conn.send_command("show configuration commands | grep ospf")
print("\nVyOS OSPF config:")
print(out)

# Verify FRR
out = conn.send_command("vtysh -c 'show running-config'")
print("\nFRR running config:")
print(out)

time.sleep(15)

out = conn.send_command("show ip ospf neighbor")
print("\nOSPF neighbors:")
print(out)

out = conn.send_command("show ip ospf interface")
print("\nOSPF interfaces:")
print(out)

out = conn.send_command("show ip route")
print("\nRoutes:")
print(out)

conn.disconnect()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fix HQ-Edge: BGP local-pref swap, NAT rule 110, OSPF default-info."""
from netmiko import ConnectHandler
import time

conn = ConnectHandler(host="192.168.122.11", device_type="vyos", username="vyos", password="test")

commands = [
    # Fix BGP local-preference: swap ISP-A-IN and ISP-B-IN
    "set policy route-map ISP-A-IN rule 10 set local-preference 200",
    "delete policy route-map ISP-B-IN rule 10 set local-preference",
    # Fix NAT rule 110: eth1 -> eth2
    "set nat source rule 110 outbound-interface name eth2",
    # Fix OSPF default-information originate: remove 'always'
    "delete protocols ospf default-information originate always",
    "set protocols ospf default-information originate",
]

out = conn.send_config_set(commands, exit_config_mode=False)
print("Config set:", out)

out = conn.commit()
print("Commit:", out)

out = conn.send_command_timing("save")
print("Save:", out)

out = conn.send_command_timing("exit")
print("Exit:", out)

# Verify VyOS config
out = conn.send_command("show configuration commands | grep -E 'route-map|nat|default-info'")
print("\nRelevant VyOS config:")
print(out)

# Verify FRR
out = conn.send_command("vtysh -c 'show running-config'")
print("\nFRR running config:")
print(out)

time.sleep(5)

# Check BGP
out = conn.send_command("show ip bgp")
print("\nBGP table:")
print(out)

out = conn.send_command("show ip route")
print("\nRoutes:")
print(out)

out = conn.send_command("show nat source rules")
print("\nNAT rules:")
print(out)

conn.disconnect()
